# Dossier

> Research-backed personalized outbound openers for B2B agencies and founders. CSV delivery in 24–48 hours.

Dossier researches each prospect, writes three QA-scored first lines, and delivers a ready-to-import CSV. No sequencer access required.

## Product

- Personalized first lines grounded in public research signals
- Three opener variants per prospect with QA scoring
- Confidence flags for thin-profile leads
- Compatible with Smartlead, Instantly, Lemlist, and CSV-based sequencers
